# icon

The **icon** field type — one user-picked Material Symbols name
(`SavedSymbolName`), or `null` for "none chosen, use the default". The
colourless sibling of `avatar` (icon + colour): use it where a thing carries a
glyph but no tint, e.g. a DataView view's switcher icon.

This barrel registers ONLY the `FieldIdentity` in the `fields.identity`
registry.

- `plugins/config` — the `iconField` factory (core) and the icon-picker
  renderer contributed to `config-v2.fields.renderer` (web).
